name: Edwards & Sanborn Solar + Energy Storage project, Kern County, California (Terra-Gen)
description: about USD 2 bn project: 875 MW solar PV with 3,287 MWh of lithium-ion battery storage (about 1,300 MW discharge); largest of its kind when completed; first phases from 2021, full operation 2023

sources.note: Central California economic development, 19 Jul 2023 (USD 2 bn, 3,287 MWh); Latham & Watkins, 9 Aug 2021 (phase 1: 346 MWac / 1,501 MWh); read 2026-10-28
